```{r}
experiment_phase <- "L122136"
task_clean <- read.csv(paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/cleaned/task_clean.csv"))
quest_clean <- read.csv(paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/cleaned/questionnaire_clean.csv"))

```

# 1. Some desriptive stats

```{r}
## Gender
cat("Gender:\n")
table(quest_clean$gender)

## Age
cat("\n\nAge:\n")
table(quest_clean$age)

## Political Party
cat("\n\nPolitical Party:\n")
table(quest_clean$vote1)

## Education
cat("\n\nEducation (%):\n")
table(quest_clean$edu) / length(quest_clean$edu) * 100

```
